content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Killeen

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific hour thresholds based on your educational background. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you document your experience and confirm readiness before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend all required sessions on a schedule that fits your work and personal commitments in the Killeen area. You'll receive a Certificate of Completion upon finishing, which you'll need for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Apply directly to PMI with your course completion certificate, proof of experience, and payment of the exam fee. PMI reviews your application to confirm eligibility. Allow time for processing before scheduling your exam appointment with Pearson VUE.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and instructor guidance, to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Pass the computer-based PMP exam to earn your credential and PMI membership.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Every three years, renew your PMP certification by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, and professional contributions. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to support your ongoing compliance and career growth in project management.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
